title: Locality claim reconciler and graceful drain protocol for private/VPC nodes
creator: Marco Chen
description: Build a daemon + control-plane integration (Locality Claim Reconciler) that validates and enforces node locality claims for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments, coordinates a graceful drain protocol when regional failover would violate residency or retention constraints, and automatically emits tamper-evident compliance bundles for auditors. This ticket focuses on the enforcement and evidence automation side: - reconcile reported node locality vs. expected jurisdiction in the residency manifest - block/mark requests if discrepancy risks customer policy violations - if planned or forced failover crosses jurisdictions, trigger quarantine mode + evidence bundle generation and hold traffic according to policy - integrate with retention engine to ensure retention scopes follow node locality changes - expose telemetry and audit events to Console and our evidence exporter
acceptance_criteria: Locality Reconciler service runs in private clusters and reconciles node-reported location with customer residency manifest within 2 minutes of node startup or topology change.

Graceful drain protocol drains user traffic from a node if a planned failover would place data outside allowed jurisdictions; drain completes without >1% increase in p95 latency for active customers on affected nodes.

Cross-jurisdiction failover must automatically produce an evidence bundle (signed manifest, node attestations, retention-adjustment log, timeline of actions) and push to the customer-specified evidence sink (S3 or M365) within 15 minutes of quarantine start.
All enforcement decisions and evidence artifacts are logged to the audit stream with immutable identifiers; Console shows per-customer residency status and a link to the latest evidence bundle.
Unit and integration tests cover simulated node-claim spoofing, network partitions, and on-prem clock skew scenarios; security review completed and approved.

risks: False positives in locality reconciliation could unnecessarily quarantine healthy nodes — mitigated by 2-step validation and human-in-the-loop option for enterprise tier.
Large customers with sustained traffic could be impacted by drains — mitigation: staged drain + traffic rerouting lanes and capacity-aware throttles.
Evidence bundles contain sensitive metadata; must ensure encryption-at-rest, signed timestamps, and customer KMS integration.
Time drift between on-prem nodes and control plane can break attestation; will require monotonic counters and signed heartbeat to avoid relying on local clocks.
